Clean — only the README edit and the new screenshot. Committing and pushing to the branch:

Done. Added a gameplay screenshot to the top of the README and pushed it.

## What I did
- **Generated a real screenshot** from the running app using the existing Playwright harness (ran a solo Hunter bot until the snake grew, then captured the board with its HUD). No stock/placeholder image.
- Saved it to `docs/screenshot.png` and added a centered hero image right under the title, with descriptive alt text.
- **Cleaned up** the throwaway capture spec so `tests/e2e/` is back to its original 6 files.
- **Committed & pushed** to `docs/update-readme` (commit `7f122af`).

I picked the classic isometric-gameplay shot (long green snake, red apple, score/level HUD) as the clearest representation of the game. I also captured an **Iron Snake** shot (irregular board) as an alternative — if you'd rather lead with that to showcase the mode I just documented, I can swap it in a few seconds. You saw both above.

The branch `docs/update-readme` now has two commits (README content + screenshot). Want me to open the PR with the `jolli-pr` skill?

(Heads-up again: the push flagged **3 Dependabot vulnerabilities** on the default branch — 1 high, 1 moderate, 1 low. Separate from this work, but happy to triage them if you want.)

Let me check the working tree — I committed and pushed the screenshot last turn, so there may be nothing new to commit.

Nothing to commit — the screenshot was already committed and pushed last turn.

- Working tree is **clean**
- Branch is **up to date** with `origin/docs/update-readme`
- Latest commit: `7f122af` "Add gameplay screenshot to top of README" (already on the remote)

Both changes are in and pushed:
1. `4fa4f0e` — Iron Snake Mode + Playwright docs, removed stale `B` control
2. `7f122af` — hero gameplay screenshot at the top

Nothing more to do here. Want me to open the PR with the `jolli-pr` skill?

Pushed — Git reports **"Everything up-to-date."**

The branch `docs/update-readme` was already fully in sync with `origin`, so there was nothing new to send. Both commits (`4fa4f0e` docs update, `7f122af` screenshot) are on the remote.

Want me to open the PR next?
I don't like that scerenshot for the hero banner.  Can you get a better one that has iron mode, a non-square board, and a hole in it

I'll capture a fresh Iron Snake shot. Let me first find the HUD element ids so I can track the level (higher levels have bigger, more visible holes), then write a capture that bursts frames during auto-rotation and picks a good isometric angle.

Holes are just gaps in the board surface (the yellow block is only the death marker), so I need a good isometric angle to see the notch. I'll enable Iron Snake, run a bot until it reaches level 2–3 (bigger, more visible holes), and burst-capture frames across the auto-rotation so I can pick a frame with a clear non-square shape + visible hole.

26 frames captured, mostly at **level 3** (bigger holes). Let me view a spread across the rotation to find one with a clear non-square outline and a visible hole at a good angle.

These are far better — clearly Iron Snake (note the "To goal" HUD) with irregular, notched board outlines. But I need an **interior hole** clearly visible, and the snake covers the middle in most. Right after leveling to 3 (frames 02–05) the snake is short, so holes should be exposed. Let me check those.

**iron-02** is the winner. It shows exactly what you asked for:
- **Iron Snake mode** (HUD reads "To goal: 15 pts", Level 3)
- A clearly **non-square, irregular board** (notched/stepped outline)
- An unmistakable **interior hole** — the dark rectangular gap in the board surface at center-left
- Plus the snake head with eyes and the red apple, at a nice isometric angle

Let me swap it in, update the alt text, clean up the temp spec, and commit.

`cp` is also aliased to interactive and skipped the overwrite. Let me force it.

Git sees `docs/screenshot.png` as modified. Let me verify it's byte-identical to iron-02, then update the alt text.

Checksums match. Now let me update the README alt text to describe the new Iron Snake image accurately.
